Third-party libraries embedded in the downloadable one-file game (`bin-rocket-sky.html`) so its local room
works with no internet. The hosted page loads the same versions from cdnjs / jsDelivr.

- `qrcode.min.js`: qrcode-generator 1.4.4 by Kazuhiko Arase, MIT License (https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator)
- `jsQR.min.js`: jsQR 1.4.0 by Cosmo Wolfe, Apache License 2.0 (https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR)
